name: Fu-ta-ba
source:
Main character's father remarries to a woman with twin daughters. After half a year father dies leaving protagonist in change of mother-in-law and step sisters. Girls start to pay excessive attention to their new guardian.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的父亲再婚，对方带着一对双胞胎女儿。半年后，父亲去世，主人公便负责照顾继母和继妹。少女们开始过分关注她们的新监护人。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
